rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label and notes image limitations, but several described features (clear ICM upper quadrant, cohesive TE throughout, precise blastocoel assessment) are not confidently discernible from this cropped image and may be somewhat inferred.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, tubal factor, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear chain from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and assumptions about attrition/post-fertilization course.

Largely aligned with IVF practice regarding transfer of a good-quality blastocyst, counseling on age-related aneuploidy, smoking cessation, and protocol review; minor deviations include strong endorsement of PGT-A and supplements/DFI testing where evidence is more nuanced.
Provides clear immediate and future recommendations, including transfer decision, luteal support, smoking cessation, protocol reassessment, and further counseling/planning steps.
